home.aboutTitle: Modern dentistry, in the heart of Sarajevo
home.aboutText: Poliklinika Bandić — Dental Ortodont Centar dr Bandić — is one of the most modernly equipped dental centers in Bosnia and Herzegovina and the wider region. Our team of more than 20 experts, including specialists in oral surgery, implantology, orthodontics and prosthetics, works across two daily shifts so you can be seen early in the morning or after work — Monday to Saturday.
home.whyTitle: Care built around precision and trust

why.title: Specialist-led team
why.text: 11 in-house specialists spanning orthodontics, oral surgery, implantology and prosthetics — not general practitioners covering every field.

why.title: Registered, traceable implants
why.text: Every implant we place is registered with the FBiH Agency for Medicines and Medical Devices. Patients receive an international implant passport.

why.title: World-recognised brands
why.text: We work with globally trusted implant systems including Straumann, Neodent and Bredent.

why.title: Two shifts, six days a week
why.text: Open Monday–Friday 07:00–21:00 and Saturday 08:00–16:00, built for people who can't take time off during standard hours.

why.title: Genuinely international
why.text: English and German spoken throughout the clinic, with a workflow designed for patients travelling from abroad.

why.title: Transparent pricing
why.text: A clear, published price list and a free personalised quote before you ever book a flight.

home.servicesTitle: Comprehensive dental care under one roof

tourism.title: Same expertise. A fraction of the price.
tourism.text: Patients from Germany, Austria, Switzerland, the UK and Scandinavia travel to Sarajevo every month for treatment at Poliklinika Bandić — combining specialist-level dentistry with real savings and a short city break.
tourism.point1: Save significantly vs. Western European price lists
tourism.point2: Free treatment plan from your OPG / X-ray before you travel
tourism.point3: One coordinator, from first email to your flight home

home.trustTitle: Trusted by patients, recognised by peers
home.trustText: Poliklinika Bandić is consistently ranked among the top 5 best-rated dental polyclinics in Bosnia and Herzegovina. Read verified patient reviews on our Google and Facebook pages.

finalCta.title: Ready to talk about your smile?
finalCta.text: Send us a photo, an X-ray, or just a question. Our team replies with a real answer — not a sales script.

serviceCategories.title: Conservative Dentistry
serviceCategories.short: Examinations, fillings, root canal treatment and everyday dental care.
serviceCategories.text: The foundation of good oral health: thorough examinations, cavity treatment and aesthetic fillings performed with modern composite materials, plus emergency care when a toothache won't wait.

serviceCategories.title: Oral Surgery
serviceCategories.short: Tooth extractions, wisdom teeth and minor surgical procedures.
serviceCategories.text: Our oral surgery specialists handle everything from routine extractions to complex wisdom tooth removal and pre-prosthetic surgery, using local anaesthesia and a careful, low-anxiety approach.

serviceCategories.title: Implantology
serviceCategories.short: Straumann, Neodent and Bredent implant systems, fully documented.
serviceCategories.text: Missing teeth replaced with registered, world-recognised implant systems. Every patient receives a written treatment plan after the first assessment and an international implant passport once treatment is complete.

serviceCategories.title: Orthodontics
serviceCategories.short: Fixed and removable braces for children and adults.
serviceCategories.text: From removable plates and functional appliances for growing jaws to fixed metal, aesthetic ceramic and self-ligating braces for teenagers and adults, planned by our specialists in jaw orthopedics.

serviceCategories.title: Prosthetics
serviceCategories.short: Zirconia and metal-ceramic crowns, bridges, fixed and removable dentures.
serviceCategories.text: Fixed prosthetics (crowns and bridges in zirconia, Emax or metal-ceramic) and mobile prosthetics for patients missing several or all teeth, restoring both function and appearance.

serviceCategories.title: Aesthetic Dentistry
serviceCategories.text: In-office lamp and power whitening for a brighter smile in a single visit, plus aesthetic restorations designed to look completely natural.

hero.title: Expert dental care, without the Western European price tag
hero.subtitle: Sarajevo is a two-hour flight from most European capitals — and Poliklinika Bandić has spent years building a workflow specifically for patients who travel for treatment: free remote quotes, specialist care, and a clear plan for how long you'll need to stay.
hero.cta: Send your X-ray for a free quote

why.title: Why patients fly to Sarajevo for dental care

items.title: Real savings
items.text: Typically 50–75% less than equivalent private treatment in Germany, Austria, Switzerland or the UK — see the comparison below.

items.title: EU-recognised materials
items.text: Implants and ceramics from internationally certified brands (Straumann, Neodent, Bredent), registered with the FBiH Agency for Medicines and Medical Devices.

items.title: No language barrier
items.text: Consultations available in English and German, with all documentation explained clearly before you commit to anything.

items.title: Short, easy trip
items.text: Direct or one-stop flights from most major European hubs; visa-free entry for EU, UK, US, CH and most European citizens.

items.title: A city worth visiting
items.text: Sarajevo pairs Ottoman old-town charm, Austro-Hungarian architecture and genuinely low living costs — many patients turn treatment into a short holiday.

items.title: One point of contact
items.text: A dedicated coordinator handles your quote, scheduling and questions from your first email to your flight home.

stay.title: How long should you stay?
stay.subtitle: A general guide — your dentist will confirm exact timing once your treatment plan is ready.

items.title: Check-up, cleaning & small fillings
items.text: Diagnosis and treatment can usually be completed in a single short trip.

items.title: Teeth whitening
items.text: In-office whitening is completed in a single appointment.

items.title: Crowns, bridges & veneers
items.text: Time needed for preparation, precise fitting and any laboratory work between appointments.

items.title: Dental implants
items.duration: 3 – 5 days, then 3 – 6 months healing, then 3 – 5 days
items.text: First visit: assessment and implant placement. After the bone heals at home, a short second visit completes the final crown or bridge.

items.title: Full mouth rehabilitation
items.text: Complex, multi-tooth cases are planned across two visits with healing time in between.

items.title: Orthodontics (braces)
items.duration: 2 – 3 days to fit, then periodic check-ins
items.text: Best suited to patients who can visit regularly, or combined with remote monitoring between check-ups.

process.title: From first message to your new smile

steps.title: Send your X-ray & photos
steps.text: Upload your OPG / panoramic X-ray, any CT scans, and a few photos of your smile using the form below — no appointment needed yet.

steps.title: Get your free treatment plan
steps.text: Our specialists review your case and reply with a written plan, timeline and price — usually within 1–2 business days.

steps.title: Book your dates
steps.text: Once you're happy with the plan, we help you choose travel dates and share practical tips on flights and accommodation.

steps.title: Treatment in Sarajevo
steps.text: Your coordinator meets you at the clinic, guides you through every appointment, and makes sure nothing feels unfamiliar.

steps.title: Aftercare, wherever you are
steps.text: You leave with full documentation, an implant passport where relevant, and a direct line to your dentist for any follow-up questions.

form.title: Tell us about your case
form.subtitle: Fill in the form and, if you have them, attach your OPG / panoramic X-ray, CT scan or recent photos. Our specialists will review everything and send you a written treatment plan and price.

fields.consent: I agree to be contacted by Poliklinika Bandić about my enquiry and consent to my data and files being processed for this purpose only.
fields.submit: Send my case for a free quote

form.success: Thank you — your enquiry has been received. A specialist will get back to you within 1–2 business days.
form.error: Something went wrong sending your enquiry. Please try again or email us directly at info@doc-bandic.com.

items.q: Is the initial quote really free?
items.a: Yes. Send your X-ray, scans or photos and our specialists will review your case and send a written treatment plan with pricing at no cost and no obligation to book.

items.q: What if I don't have an OPG or X-ray yet?
items.a: That's fine — describe your situation as best you can in the message field, or plan for an in-person examination and X-ray on your first day at the clinic.

items.q: Do you speak English or German?
items.a: Yes, both are spoken at the clinic, and all treatment plans and documentation can be provided in English or German.

items.q: Can you help with accommodation or transport?
items.a: Our coordinator shares recommendations for hotels near the clinic and can advise on airport transfers, though bookings are made directly by the patient.
Card and cash payments are accepted at the clinic. Payment details for your specific treatment plan will be confirmed with your quote.
